_comment: How rtc-ship.sh ships THIS repo (run-to-completion's bin/rtc-ship.sh). Data lives here; commands a repo needs live in .rtc/*.sh, opt-in by presence. Adding this file is config-only: no version bump, no release.
_comment_tests: The pytest default alone never ran tests/test_*.sh (6 suites, 348 checks). test_cmd runs pytest AND every shell suite as concurrent GNU parallel jobs; exit = number of failed jobs, and pytest exits 5 when it collects nothing, so an empty suite still fails (2026-10-28).
test_cmd: { echo "$HOME/.local/bin/pytest -q tests -p no:cacheprovider -n 8"; for t in tests/test_*.sh; do echo "bash $t"; done; } | parallel --will-cite -j 12
